verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say notes can always be exported into an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeats this on HN as the answer to lock-in concerns. That covers the core of an export path that outlives the vendor. Missing for 10: JSON or other structured export (only imports from Roam JSON are documented), detail on what the export preserves (backlinks, tags, metadata, attached files/images), and independent hands-on confirmation of export quality.
